Title: Minimum output validity checks
Text: 1. The four document files exist after a successful Pass 1 run. 2. `DECOMP_VARIANT=DOMAIN` is rejected with `UNSUPPORTED_VARIANT`. 3. `P3_ONLY` does not proceed unless the four existing documents and `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` are already present. 4. The run does not modify metadata files other than the safe `_STATUS.md` update. 5. Source-grounding gaps appear as `TBD`, assumptions, or conflict-table entries rather than invented content. 6. The run stays within the target deliverable folder. 7. Every warranted item ID in `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` has a Pass 3 disposition, and no stale/nonexistent item IDs are referenced. 8. `python3 tools/validation/validate_p3_disposition.py {DELIVERABLE_PATH}` passes before the Pass 3 output is accepted.

Title: Failure reporting expectations
Text: Use `FAILED_INPUTS` when: - authoritative source materials are unavailable, - required existing files for `P3_ONLY` are missing, - overwrite protection blocks the run.  Use `UNSUPPORTED_VARIANT` when `DECOMP_VARIANT=DOMAIN`.

Title: Required evidence/log expectations
Text: - Record inaccessible source materials as missing. - Record source rereads for substantive Pass 3 changes. - Record any conflict-table additions when source materials and decomposition context disagree. - Record item-by-item Pass 3 disposition evidence for all warranted `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` rows.
